verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a SaaS remote-desktop service with accounts and audit logs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a fixed 7-day audit-log window, peer-to-peer connections that bypass Parsec's infrastructure, and a 'Privacy mode' feature. None of these documents user-controllable retention settings or data deletion, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
